blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: «за» + accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is a diamond in the rough.
exercises.why: «с» + instrumental plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Конь - единственная фигура, которая может перешагивать через другие ___ (фигура).
exercises.prompt: The knight is the only piece that can jump over other pieces.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: To stand on your own two feet means to be independent.
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He doesn't give a fig about money.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«к» + dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я не верю в ___ (заклинание) и чары.
exercises.prompt: I don't believe in spells and charms.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

«на» + accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
